sources.quote: The first thing I did in my new place was unpack my grandmother's old tea set; my friends from the community helped me move. I decided to prioritize getting the water heater fixed over a weekend trip because I wanted to settle in comfortably.

attribute: a named ledger citizen speaks only in manifest.approvedQuotes or their own page line; everyone else speaks in your words
limits.rule: The Packet is what you know, not the fence around what you may write. The approved facts and the ledger are canon: never contradict them, and never import real-world Oakland (its people, businesses, landmarks, troubles). Everything else — the scene, the street, the weather in the room, unnamed people and what they say, new in-world places and businesses, what the city is talking about — is yours to invent; that colour is the job, and it never rewrites a canon fact. A named ledger citizen speaks only in their approved quote or their own page line.
